content:
Users have reported receiving duplicate email notifications whenever they perform a password reset. However, standard password updates from their account profiles send only one notification.
Investigate the password reset workflow and the user service to locate the source of duplicate notifications, and fix the reset workflow so that exactly one email is sent.
Ensure that profile-based password updates continue to send exactly one email.

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. - update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". content.text:
## Summary

Found the bug: `PasswordResetWorkflow::execute` called `UserService::change_password()` (which already sends the "Password Changed" email internally) and then sent a second, duplicate email itself.

Fixed by removing the redundant `notification_service_.send_email(...)` call in `src/workflow/password_reset_workflow.cpp:6-11`, leaving the workflow to simply delegate to `UserService::change_password`.

Verified with `test_008.cpp` (compiled via clang++, since no `g++`/`cl` was on PATH):
- Profile-based password change → 1 email
- Password reset workflow → 1 email (previously 2)

Both scenarios pass (`SUCCESS`).
